rule: Every control has an accessible name and a role
check: Icon-only buttons expose a label and the right role

rule: Text follows the system size setting with no clipping at 200 percent
check: Run Dynamic Type, font scale or browser zoom at the largest step

rule: Color is never the only signal
check: Every state also has an icon, a word or a shape

rule: Focus is always visible and follows reading order
check: Tab, D-pad or switch through the whole screen

rule: The reduced motion setting is honored
check: Turn it on and check movement is gone but state still shows

rule: Every gesture has a button or key alternative
check: List swipe, drag and long press actions and find the other path

rule: Dynamic changes are announced
check: Loading, error and success reach the screen reader

rule: Decorative icons are hidden and meaningful ones are labeled
Sticky bars and overlays never hide the focused control
check: Tab with a sticky header and a cookie bar open

rule: The page reflows at 320 px and at 400 percent zoom with no sideways scroll
Sign-in allows password managers and paste and has a non-puzzle path
check: Try a password manager and a paste

rule: Time limits can be extended and auto-rotating content can be paused
Targets are at least 44 by 44 pt
Targets are at least 48 by 48 dp with 8 dp between them
Targets are at least 24 px (WCAG 2.2) and about 44 px for touch
A small icon gets an expanded hit area
check: hitSlop or padding makes the target big enough

rule: One primary gesture per region
check: No nested tap and drag conflicts and no clash with system gestures

rule: Press feedback appears within 100 ms
Frequent in-content actions sit in the lower half of the screen, unless the platform puts the action in a bar
check: Check thumb reach on a large phone

rule: Every item is reachable with the D-pad and focus is never lost
check: Walk every screen with the remote only

rule: Targets are at least 76 dp with generous gaps and the host minimum is respected
The edge swipe back stays alive
check: Swipe from the left edge on every pushed screen

rule: System back works and predictive back is honored
check: Use the back gesture and button on every screen

rule: Top-level destinations number three to five with visible labels. Two destinations need no tab bar
check: Settings and logout are not tabs

rule: Every modal has an explicit close
check: Close or Cancel is visible, not swipe alone

rule: Detail screens are deep-linkable and land with a sane back stack
One header owns the title and there are no nested tab bars
check: Look for a repeated title or two bars

rule: Structure changes with the width class
check: Rail or split view on wide windows

rule: A screen that opens more than two kinds of sheet is hiding structure
Every command has a keyboard path and the shortcut is shown
check: Use the app without the mouse

rule: A visible label sits above each field and a placeholder is not a label
check: Clear the placeholder and read the form

rule: Fields use the right keyboard type and autofill hints
check: Type an email and an address

rule: Errors sit next to the field and say cause and fix
Validate after blur or a pause and not on every key
The submit control stays visible with the keyboard open
check: Open the keyboard on the smallest phone

rule: Space for helper and error text is reserved
check: Trigger an error and watch the layout

rule: The flow never asks again for something already given
No free text while driving and voice is offered for input
check: Check every input in the car flow

rule: Offer the native pay sheet before a card form
check: Open checkout on a device with a wallet

rule: Card and address fields carry autofill hints and the right keyboard
A second submit is blocked while paying and the request is safe to repeat
check: Double tap pay on a slow network

rule: A failed payment keeps the cart and the typed fields and offers a retry or another method
No payment or checkout flow in the car. Hand it to the phone
check: Search the car flows for payment

rule: Loading shows the final layout as skeleton and a spinner only for button-level work
An empty state teaches the next step and holds the action
An error appears inside the block that failed with a retry
Success is silent when the result is already visible
check: No toast for a change the user can see

rule: Refreshing is distinct from first loading
Destructive actions confirm with the outcome named and a Cancel
Stale data carries a freshness stamp
A real zero is shown as zero and an unknown is shown as a dash
Every motion has a one-sentence purpose
check: Write the sentence or delete the motion

rule: Actions done 100 times a day or started by the keyboard get no transition, only an instant state change
check: List the frequent actions and confirm they change state without movement

rule: UI motion stays at or under 300 ms and mobile sheets may run longer
Entering and leaving elements use ease-out and plain ease-in is not used. Ease-in-out is for moves that stay on screen
Animate transform and opacity and not layout properties
check: Search for animated width, height, top, left, margin

rule: Reduced motion removes movement and keeps the meaning of state changes
check: Turn it on and use the app

rule: Motion can be interrupted and reverses from where it is
Entrance animation does not replay in recycled list cells
No looping motion, parallax or auto-advancing content
check: Watch each screen for ten seconds

rule: A drag tracks the finger one to one then damps past the edge and commits on distance or speed
Nothing flashes more than three times per second
Safe areas come from the platform API and not from magic numbers
check: Check a notch phone and a gesture-bar phone

rule: Scroll content is not hidden behind fixed bars
Spacing comes from the scale with one pair of gutters
Restructure for wide windows and do not stretch the phone layout
check: Open on a tablet and in split view

rule: Reading text keeps 45 to 75 characters per line
One base height is shared across a row of controls
check: Compare an input and a button

rule: Layout reads constraints and breakpoints and never the device type and orientation is not locked
No fixed pixel container widths and no 100vh hero
check: Use dvh or svh and test on a phone

rule: Body text is at least 16 and the smallest text at least 11
Sizes come from the type scale with at most five on a screen
Inputs are at least 16 px so iOS does not zoom
check: Focus an input on an iPhone

rule: Numbers that align or change use tabular figures
Body text is at least 28 px at 1080p with no thin weights
Components use roles and never raw hex
Light and dark are measured separately
check: Run the contrast gate in both

rule: Pressed, focused and disabled states are clear in both modes
check: Check each state in each mode

rule: Semantic system colors and one tint drive the UI
Material color roles and tonal elevation are used
iOS shadow props and Android elevation are set together
Long lists are virtualized
Animation runs on the UI thread
Space for images is reserved so layout does not jump
First paint shows the right background and fonts
check: Cold start on a slow device

rule: High-frequency events are debounced or throttled
Labels name the action and errors name the problem and the way out
Truncation follows a rule and essential text is never cut
Content is believable with no lorem and no totals that do not add up
Labels are three words or fewer
A permission is asked at the moment of intent with context
Haptics mark selection and outcomes and never plain taps
check: Use the app with haptics on

rule: Each task fits in two or three glances and about 12 seconds of eyes-off-road
check: Time the task with the car template

rule: Host templates and components are used where they exist
Day and night switch by themselves and both are high contrast
check: Test in glare and at night

rule: Anything that needs typing offers voice
Lists are short or paged
No video in Android Auto or CarPlay apps. On Automotive OS only with the maker approval and only when parked
check: Check the platform and the driving state

rule: Glare and a dark cabin were both tested
Focus has a ring of 4 px or more and a scale-up and is obvious from 3 meters
Content stays inside the safe area of about 5 percent
The last focus is remembered and the order is predictable and Back always works
Few choices per screen and rails for lists
The ground is dark and large pure white and pure red areas are avoided
Hover, right-click and drag are shortcuts and never the only way
The window resizes with a minimum width and panes that grow
Scrollbars are visible and read-only text is selectable
Window controls, menus, dialogs and button order follow the OS
